text: In mercenaries dastardy is most dangerous; in auxiliaries, valour. The wise prince, therefore, has always avoided these arms and turned to his own; and has been willing rather to lose with them than to conquer with the others, not deeming that a real victory which is gained with the arms of others.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIII, Concerning auxiliaries, mixed soldiery, and one's own
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
